summary: Stops accepting work and waits for all accepted factories and tasks to finish.

p: Cancellation only stops this caller's wait; admission remains closed and accepted work remains owned. Each returned task retains its original outcome. A faulted task is logged once (event 1013) without failing the drain; cancellations are not logged. Call again or dispose asynchronously to await completion after a cancelled wait.

When called from accepted work of this scope, including code that inherits its execution context, the drain waits for all other accepted work but not for the calling work, which cannot finish while it awaits its own drain. Work such as "Save and close" can therefore dispose its owner. Code that runs in that work after the drain must not rely on resources the owner releases.
